title: Buying a crate without filling the back room
target: How to buy and open crates in Supermarket Simulator without turning the storage room into a wall of unopened stock.
version: 1.6.0 (223), read from the copy of the game this site was built from (see the sources page)
prerequisites: Room to put a crate down
Money for the crate as well as for ordinary stock
Shelves that will take what comes out

steps.do: Decide where the crate will be opened before you buy it.
steps.because: a crate is an object of its own rather than a shelf (Crate)

steps.do: Buy it as its own purchase rather than assuming it arrives with an order.
steps.because: the game has a sale item for a crate (CrateSaleItem)

steps.do: Open it in the shop rather than leaving it sealed in the back.
steps.because: a crate has an interaction for dealing with it in the world (CrateInteraction)

steps.do: Expect the contents to be laid out rather than all in one place.
steps.because: the game keeps a numbered grid for a crate (CrateGridNumbersAuto)

steps.do: Check the shop when you are in a shared game, since the crate is shared.
steps.because: the crate interaction is carried on the network (NetworkCrateInteraction)

commonMistakes: Buying crates faster than you can open them.
Opening one with nowhere to put the contents.
Assuming a crate is a shelf and leaving it sealed.
sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
